notes.title: Release demo version of the Sharded World: Backpack Adventure!
notes.content:
Dear players, we are excited to announce that the time has come for you to enjoy the project "Sharded World: Backpack Adventure". This is a game where you can demonstrate your tactical skills, unconventional thinking, and just have fun defeating your opponents.


What awaits you?

- The ability to equip your character for battle. Currently, there are two classes available in the game: adventurer and sorceress.
- A starting backpack with a minimal set of items. Upon visiting the shop, you will be able to collect your first recipes by purchasing the missing items and head into battle.
- In battle, you will encounter players with a wide variety of backpack combinations. Gradually, you will need to build defense against different types of damage, as well as remember to strike at the enemy yourself.

Devise your tactics, combine talents and items, become invincible, and progress through the ranking system, facing more experienced players in battle!

Don't miss the chance to be among the first to try the game and share your opinion with the developers! Your feedback will help us make the game even better.

Join the adventure today and start your journey to the top of the rankings in "Sharded World: Backpack Adventure"!

notes.title: Breaking news heroes!
notes.content:
Hero news! The explorers who came from the dungeon began to tell horror stories, as if their fallen comrades were getting back on their feet and attacking them. They also noticed that a strange slime-like liquid with yellow eyes was visible on their heads. They are sure that this slime is the problem. Pack your backpack and set off on a journey to figure out what the root of the problem is....

Our team is pleased to announce that we are expanding the Sharded World game universe and will soon present you a new game Sharded World: Backpack Adventure!

What is Sharded World: Backpack Adventure? It is an exciting game that will allow you to show your strategic and creative skills. In this game you will have to build your own backpack, purchase equipment, improve it and use it to defeat your opponents in exciting fights.

You are a zombie slime whose main power is to control the bodies and minds of creatures.
Taking over the bodies of heroes, slimes fight to prove their superiority over the rest. 
Here you have a chance to capture the hero's body, and finally enter the battle for recognition. 
With the help of the hero you will be able to purchase backpacks and items from the merchant, improve and combine them to become stronger. 
Create various interesting combinations of equipment that would surpass your opponent and become the strongest in the dungeon and show who is the boss of the house!
Learn more about the game here Sharded World: Backpack Adventure


And don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
Welcome to all Sharded World players!
We are pleased to announce the release of a major update for our game. In this update, we have added a new Miner NPC, a function for disassembling weapons and equipment items in the forge, as well as a number of other changes to improve gameplay.

New NPC Miner
In the update we have added a new NPC Miner. The Miner will be located in the lower left part of the guild in the hut near the descent to the mines. You will be able to trade resources with him. This will allow you to get access to the resources you need without spending time mining them, as well as exchange those that you have a surplus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/8aad86cd3d1b53195e03fc1e08ebbc9d4166cfab.gif

Weapon and equipment disassembly feature
In the update we have added the function of disassembling weapons and equipment items at the blacksmith. Now you will be able to disassemble unwanted weapons and equipment items to get resources to improve your main items. This will allow you to use resources more efficiently and improve your items faster.

Other changes

We have also made the following changes in the update:

 Expanded the notification system to give players more detailed information about what's happening in the game.
 Fixed a number of bugs and improved game stability.
 Improved the game balance to make the gameplay more balanced and fair.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Greetings to all Sharded World players!

We are pleased to announce the release of a new update that includes the following changes:

 Bugfixes we have made every effort to fix as many bugs as possible. 
 Step Counter: Players can now see how many steps they have taken in the game. This can be useful for players who want to track their progress or just want to know how many they have walked.
 Changed sort order in the leaderboard: Players with the lowest number of steps are now ranked first on the leaderboard. This should make the leaderboard more fair and honest.

We hope you enjoy these new changes. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Sharded World at the Shoetemps Festival!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that our game Sharded World will be participating in the Steam Shutemaps Festival!.

This event will take place from September 25 to October 2 and will include a sale, as well as sections for upcoming and demo games.

As part of the festival, Sharded World will be available at 10% off. This is a great opportunity to familiarize yourself with the game if you haven't already.

In addition, we have prepared an updated demo version for new players. It will feature limited content of the full version for new players will be a great opportunity to touch the basic mechanics and features of the game .

Баланс улучшений
The prices of upgrades have now been lowered and the improvement you receive is greater. This will allow players to improve their characters and equipment faster.We hope that these changes will make upgrades more affordable and attractive to players.

Новые локализации
We have also prepared for you new localizations such as:

 German
 Polish
 French
 Spanish 
 Chinese


There is a surprise update coming soon, which will be codenamed "Banana". What is this update? You will find out very soon!

We hope you'll join us at the Shutemaps Festival and enjoy playing Sharded World!.

notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
Dear players, after many days and nights of hard work we are happy to announce one of the biggest updates in the game!

For your sake we have worked on the smallest details, optimized the smallest mechanics, and added even more content, because it is important to us that you were able to get the most out of the game.

New weapons:

Mystic Arrow secret weapon added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/db6e48fc0d60e23cb37c2081c8f814f5697d4f0e.gif
made of a mysterious metal that has become an object of curiosity and horror. Legend has it that this metal was created by ancient dragons and mysterious spirits, and it can penetrate the strongest armor and cut through the souls of its enemies.

But what makes the Mystic Arrow truly unique is its connection to nature. The arrow responds to birdsong and the calls of wildlife. When a Hero equipped with this weapon gives commands similar to bird whistles, it accompanies her on her way to her target. This makes the arrow as flexible and accurate as if it had gained a mind of its own.

Legend also states "to obtain this weapon you must follow the celestial bird...".

"Bow of Split Shot". 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/f26cbc25172a0e59c3eb7441b4df78cd10dd09bc.gif
Is a bow with a sinister past and otherworldly powers. Created from the branches and root of an ancient tree, it has been tempered in the heart of the bake to give it magical strength and bind it to dark forces. The Order of the Black Blade believed that weapons must be as dark and terrible as those they face in order to intimidate their enemies forever.

With this powerful bow, your character will gain a new and effective way to fight! Allows you to release multiple arrows at once that fly swiftly towards your target. Now you can hit multiple enemies at once, dealing massive damage and killing enemies at a distance.

"Arcane Bolt"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/e7b560bae60eea380d3902995dfedd6fca235f8a.gif
Discovered an ancient scroll that ancient legends told of. This scroll represented a magical spell.

Unable to resist the lure of power, the mage from the ancient clan decided to activate the 'Arcane Bolt'. However, when the magic words were spoken, he suddenly lost control of the spell. The dark energy overwhelmed him, and he became a prisoner of the power he had awakened. As a result, he became a vicious and vengeful dark entity, detached from his human form.

As time passed, the hero mastered the power of weapons and now shoots powerful dark energy, which, when hit, discharges into blinding lasers that strike nearby enemies. 

New orb types:
Focus Orb is an ancient artifact that was created by an ancient master archer. It was created from the shards of worlds that fell to earth during the Lich King's invasion. The archer worked so painstakingly and long to create the orb that his soul and abilities were completely encased in the orb.
 - base effect: adds a critical hit chance that increases damage by 1.5x.
 - signature effect (Bow): adds penetration for projectiles, increases the area of search for enemies to the maximum (just 360 degrees area).

Arcane Orb is an ancient artifact that was created in a world where magic and technology coexisted in harmony. The orb was created from a shard of crystal that was found in the heart of a volcano and sealed with technology.
 - Basic effect: sets enemies on fire, dealing intermittent magical damage.
 - signature effect: increases the area of effect of Magic Beams (the line after the explosion), adds Blast when it hits an enemy.
Other changes:

 Guild roof opens 5-10 meters earlier for more convenience
 New cursors: Choose your style in customization - we have a variety of cursor icons, as well as a system cursor so you never lose sight of it.
 Dailies on the board: Now dailies will not be displayed first when you enter the board.
 Replacing Q and E keys with Tab keys to switch between tabs.
 Adding tooltips for resources so players know where to get them and how to spend them.
 Add tooltips for locked inventory slots.
 Renamed the "Orbs" tab in Blacksmith to "Orb Crafting".
 Fixed display of orbs color in crafting after restarting the game - colors will now be displayed correctly.
 Displayed red inscription if the rarity of an item does not fit the hero.
 Bright display of item names.
 Markers for equipment you have dropped will now be displayed on the floor to make it easier to find.
 Display red lettering in the tooltip when an item is turned off.
 Fixed the order of character tabs - the first tab will now contain stats, not just description.
 Added "Max" above the character's maximum stats.
 Reduced the volume of fireworks explosion sound.
 Adding tooltips for chests that will describe what drops and with what odds.
 Fixed issues with displaying kuldown and delay at the end of actions.
 Added partials to the background when opening a chest to make the process more immersive.
 Added hints comparing what you're wearing to the selected character in your inventory (two hints next to each other), in the portal and at the trainer.
 Localization bug fixes.
 Added context buttons for better in-game controls.

notes.title: The big update is already here
notes.content:
Preface
Greetings dear players, we are preparing for you a very big update that will significantly improve and diversify the gameplay. We are working very hard every day working on every little detail, so you will be pleasantly surprised, and play with maximum pleasure. Most of the content is ready, left to finalize a small part and check everything good! We expect to release the biggest game update on June 1st!

Items
New types of equipment are now available for players to diversify the gameplay, and make your game builds more flexible for the tasks you set.

You can watch the full video on youtube!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/09d0e5bac4bb96a8035eb70c3a966c0027558c2a.gif

What are items in the context of the game?
Items given by the gods to help the hero, they give additional characteristics to the character, which should facilitate and diversify the gameplay for the player. Each item has a part of the soul, which is why they have power.

What types of items are available to the player?
Each type of item is divided into subclasses, which, in turn, are divided into 4 types of rarity: common, rare, epic, and legendary.

Body - Jacket, robe, cuirass
Feet - High boots, Armor Boots, Boots
Hands - Bracelets, Gloves, Gauntlets
Head - Hat, Mask, Helmet
Rings
Backpack
Neck - Necklace, Scarf, Bevor

How do I get new items in the game?
Each time you pass the chapter you can meet mini-bosses when you kill them can drop an item of any uniqueness. With increasing difficulty levels, or changing chapters the chance of falling out of unique items increases.
Also in the future we will add unique quests and dailies that can also be rewarded with items.

What items can be used to perform specific tasks in the game?
Each item gives unique characteristics or increases existing ones, e.g. boots add movement speed, gloves add attack speed, cuirass adds armor, etc.
Also, there is a backpack, an item that helps to take with you to the level of additional items that you can dress up depending on the situation in the game. Let's say you want to get more experience or resources, just change the items from the backpack, which adds a particular characteristic. This will help you diversify the gameplay, or get more souls or resources, depending on your current need.

What items can be used in combination with others to create new features in the game?
You will be able to combine items, weapons, orbs, and characters to enhance the strengths of your equipment, or to compensate for weaknesses. You'll also be able to customize your build for certain needs, gathering resources, collecting souls, passing chapters, etc.

Heroes

Our team decided to liven up the gameplay a little, and the guild now displays your heroes. When you get a new hero, he comes to your guild, and lives next to you, at any time you can walk up to the hero and start playing as him.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/30ed922b70ca11bca82e104378bec1b4a7dc9c6e.gif

Character selection in the guild
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/7f703cbf13c7bdab073759dec248f975133854ed.gif

Renaming a character in the guild
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/faabdf64cb3d18e5cf3f8f7f8b7dfa8b9fe7f1a1.gif
You can watch the full video on youtube!

What are heroes in the game?
Heroes are copies of your character that have developed in other worlds, each of them has developed separately from the main character, thanks to which each of them received their unique abilities, looks and so on. Heroes live their lives and go about their business, but at any time you can choose a hero from the list of those that fell to you.

What types of heroes are available to players?
There are 9 classes of heroes in the game (Necromancer, Mage, Frost Mage, Ranger, Warrior, Demon Knight, Cleric, Archer, Infantryman) divided by rarity (normal, rare, epic) each hero has his own strengths and weaknesses.

How do I get new heroes in the game?
Heroes are dropped from chests, chests with heroes can be obtained by completing chapters, Challenges, Daily and Achievement.


What heroes can be used to customize a character's appearance?
Most heroes not only have unique traits, but also unique looks and you can customize the appearance of a character to suit your tastes.

How can heroes help accomplish specific tasks in the game?
You will be able to combine items, weapons, orbs and heroes to strengthen their strengths, or to compensate for their weaknesses. You'll also be able to adjust your build for specific needs, gathering resources, collecting souls, passing chapters, etc.

Redesign
Due to a significant expansion of the game mechanics, and new features,our current interface is significantly outdated.Our team decided to update and refresh the interface of the game.

We made the game interface more convenient and intuitive, fully adapted for controllers, and redesigned the visual component of the interface, (inventory, pause, dialog boxes, the portal with the characters, opening the chests, and much more.) to play was not only convenient, but also beautiful.

Also we are preparing different nice little things such as:

 Character renaming - now you'll be able to rename any character from the list of those that you already have.
 Correcting and optimizing the gameplay.
 Full adaptation and support for controllers.


Dear players, we always listen to your suggestions, we would like to hear your opinions and recommendations, write in comments below this post what you would like to see or change in the game, we will read every comment and maybe part or all of it will go into the upcoming big update! So looking forward to your comments!

Giveaway info

Our team decided to postpone it one more month, till June 15, to give more people a chance to participate, so you can still get active and invite your friends to take part! To take part you need to complete a simple small task, learn more about it in our community, or start taking action right now on our website

 Additional equipment types, which will add new slots for armor, pants, boots, helmet, gloves, rings, and necklaces. This will allow you to customize your characters and create more unique combinations.

 More detailed and interactive development of the plot, new interesting quests, guild customization depending on the leveling of NPC, and progression through the storyline.

 New mode Chasm, which will allow you to test your abilities in the vast lair of monsters. Challenge yourself and find out what you're capable of!

 Full controller support and interface adaptation for them, making the game control more precise and convenient.

 Great optimization of the gameplay, which will improve the game's performance and make it more stable

notes.title: The big update is already here!
notes.content:
Greetings players, our development team has prepared for you a big technical and narrative update, more content and features for our favorite players!

More content!
The second chapter is already here, sharpen your blades, learn new spells, draw the bowstring and go to battle! New horrible monsters are waiting for you, just eager to take a piece of your flesh! Secret traps and lifeless desert will squeeze everything out of you, and most importantly a new mad boss! Are you ready to take on this challenge? 


made unity loading faster!
For your comfort, we made changes in the structure of the game, because of the large amount of content, you might have problems waiting for the game to start, we fixed this problem and everything should load faster!

Gamepad support!
By popular demand we are adding gamepad support to the up-game menu, but this is only the beginning, we plan to completely rethink the use of a gamepad in the game and make it support the whole game so that it would be the most comfortable for you.

More platforms!
We have added support for the game on the operating system Linux, we plan to expand the support on other platforms such as MacOs, so that the players did not have unnecessary obstacles to interact with the game.

More Comfortable Game Play!
For better interaction with the game we have introduced a large number of small bugs related to various mechanics and gameplay, it should make the game easier and get the most out of the game!

you can chat in our Discord channel!

notes.title: Small update!
notes.content:
Greetings, forks, our developers have not slept for days and nights (literally), and prepared for you a list of changes in the game for more convenience.

Faster than the wind!
We changed the characteristics of the speed of the character in the guild, now he runs much faster to make you more comfortable to move around.

Controller support.
Based on player requests, we are gradually optimizing controller support for better interaction with the interface and the game.


 controller support in the lvl up menu
 controller support in the chest opening menu (session)
 in many other places


More game optimization.
We noticed that players encountered some problems that prevent getting the best game experience, so we made some changes.

Game loading, from now on you should not have to deal with long load times even on old hard drives.

Also bugs with some NPCs have been fixed, namely Coach and Blacksmith, now you should have no problems.

Game change
We added a gaze direction display for more convenience in the game session.
Players may have encountered minor interaction issues with orbs for weapons, we have fixed this issue 

Updated the price balance for permanent character buffs at Coach.

We also added the ability to reroll daily on the message board, for this you will need to sacrifice a certain amount of souls, and you will be able to pick up what suits you at the moment.

notes.title: A new victory!
notes.content:
Congratulations, heroes!

A new milestone has been reached. You have passed the 3 million monster kill line! With every swing of your sword, with every shot of your bow, with every spell, you cleanse this world of evil and evil forces! Get stronger and you will achieve more, we believe in you.Learn new weapon combinations, create your builds to speed up the process of cleansing the world from the minions of the lich king!

We are very interested in how you achieve such fast results, tell us about your favorite build in Discord, Twitter, in our community or wherever you like but don't forget to tag us,

Invite your friends to play the beta version of the game, because with friends is always better, faster and more fun, compete to reach new heights, the leaderboard and upon reaching 10 million dead monsters we will raffle off the keys for your friends in our Discord!

notes.title: three... two... one... RELEASE! 16.01.02023
notes.content:
Are you ready heroes?!

Finally, after months of development, passing all the most difficult stages, going through difficulties and overcoming setbacks, we are ready to give you a full-fledged project “Sharded World!”

We have created a world full of adventures and challenges for you, you will be in the role of a single defender in endless worlds and universes of a cruel world! You will have to defeat millions and billions of monsters with a variety of weapons and equipment, invent your own unique ways of passage, combine the main weapon, pump it, inlay orbs to amplify and change the mechanics of the weapon. Everything is just in your hands! 

You'll also be able to try on countless different images with their unique classes and abilities, as you can strengthen them with the help of trainer training to become even stronger and kill more and more diverse monsters! 

Take advantage of all the game and content opportunities to slay the bosses and their entourage and become even stronger, because this is only the beginning, in the future we plan major upgrades so you can dive into this world even deeper

Also on the release date of 16.01.2023 we prepared a small discount for all who buy the game on that day, so go ahead and adventure! And take your friends with you to see who's stronger!

notes.title: Our new project Answenarium!
notes.content:
What will the new game be about?
The main point of this game is fun and enjoyable, you can play with your friends or find new ones. During the game, participants answer questions of varying value, trying to get ahead of the opponent and collect points, who has more points and he won. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/186b15bc8ab3a5a664ce682f321846194ea3a674.png

- How does it work?
Questions can be a variety of formats: Video, photo, text, music. The game consists of at least several main rounds and a final round. Each of the main rounds contains questions on a theme of different format.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/9aa89e4f12a07656e697506cbe7b80457c54df57.png

-Themes and categories for every taste!
You can choose the theme of the game questions (such as music, movies, books, etc.) you can find by category filters in our browser for every taste and color. These packages work via the Steam trading platform, which means that all the functionality of the marketplace is at your disposal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/918f0cb9f7f76c61bdaa6d2143178d73b5d7eb48.png

-Show Your Uniqueness!
If you can not find the theme that suits you, we have developed for you a convenient and detailed designer! You will be able to design your own unique rounds, questions and themes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/018a0325c7dadd7883c1283de8b09690b02cb18f.png

-The game will be free!
We want to release a free game with open functionality that you all can have fun. 
In order for us to release the game faster we need your help! We are waiting from you to repost and add the game to the Wishlist, because your interest always creates enthusiasm for the work!

notes.title: Sharded World free game demo launched!+Key Drawing!
notes.content:
For you, my dear friend!

It's very important for our team to give as many players as possible a taste of the world of Sharded World, which we have worked so hard to create. You will be able to try all the basic gameplay elements for free:

One level for 20 minutes
Final boss battle
9 kinds of weapons
9 kinds of equipment
9 weapon evolutions
Unique level test


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081421/38da85c910c1cc8a513b95399ed858b6725e779b.png

Challenge the forces of darkness!

The bloody and brutal World of Sharded World, a large number of unique monsters that have enslaved thousands of worlds, led by King Lich and his generals! Brutality and death to all living things is the goal of the undead army! And it is YOU! Our hero will free this world from the forces of darkness and lead it into a brighter future!

Step onto the battlefield, choose your weapon and equipment, build your own unique evolution build, kill as many monsters as possible and fight the greater evil! Fight and defeat the forces of darkness, so the world can sleep in peace!

You can also take part in giving away keys to the full game of Sharded World!

The conditions are simple: Start the game, click the "play" button, and kill monsters. When the number of monsters killed in total reaches 10 million (look at Sharded World site) we will arrange a raffle among the players in our discord channel!
